=== AlgebraicJacobian/Algebra/LocalizationCocycle.lean ===
/-!
# Čech 1-cocycles on a finite localization cover as descent cocycles

Let `A` be a commutative ring and `f : ι → A` a finite family.  Fix models for the
localizations of `A` away from the single, double and triple products of the `f i`:

* `S i` with `IsLocalization.Away (f i) (S i)` — "sections on `D(f i)`";
* `T i j` with `IsLocalization.Away (f i * f j) (T i j)` — sections on the overlaps;
* `W i j k` with `IsLocalization.Away (f i * (f j * f k)) (W i j k)` — triple overlaps.

A **cover cocycle** (`IsLocalization.AwayCover.IsCoverCocycle`) is a family of units
`γ i j : (T i j)ˣ` that is `1` on the diagonal and satisfies the Čech 1-cocycle identity
on triple overlaps, all maps being the canonical (unique!) `A`-algebra maps between
localizations.  This file converts such a family into a descent 1-cocycle
`cocycleUnit γ : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ` for the cover algebra `B := ∀ i, S i`
(`Module.IsDescentCocycle`, from `AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.UnitDescent`), via the
`A`-algebra identifications `B ⊗[A] B ≃ ∀ p, T p.1 p.2` and
`B ⊗[A] (B ⊗[A] B) ≃ ∀ t, W t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2` of `AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.PiLocalization`.

The bridge lemmas (`lmul'_cocycleUnit`, `piTripleEquiv_descentFace*`,
`piDoubleEquiv_descentIncl*`) compute the images of the simplicial ring maps of
`UnitDescent` through these identifications: they become index-wise canonical restriction
maps.  Every one of them is an instance of the pi-ext principle
(`AlgHom.ext_of_isLocalization_pi`): both sides are `A`-algebra maps out of a finite
product of localizations of `A`, so it suffices to compare them on the coordinate
idempotents.

Consumers (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicAffine`) use:

* `isDescentCocycle_cocycleUnit` — the conversion;
* `cocycleUnit_mul` — multiplicativity in `γ`;
* `exists_units_of_cocycleUnit_eq_descentCoboundary` — a cocycle whose descent unit is a
  coboundary is an index-wise coboundary;
* `map_cocycleUnit` — compatibility with refinement of covers.
-/

/-!
# Finite products of localizations of a commutative ring

For a commutative ring `A` and a finite covering family of basic opens — elements
`f i : A` with `Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤` — the product `∀ i, S i` of localizations
`S i := A[1/f i]` is the algebraic incarnation of a finite affine cover of `Spec A`.  This
file provides the toolkit used by the Čech–Picard dictionary
(`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicAffine`) to run faithfully flat descent along such covers:

* `AlgHom.ext_of_isLocalization_pi` — **the pi-ext lemma**: two `A`-algebra maps out of a
  finite product of localizations of `A` agreeing on the coordinate idempotents
  `Pi.single i 1` are equal.  This makes every diagram of algebra maps out of such
  products commute by pure bookkeeping, replacing all naturality arguments downstream.
* `Module.FaithfullyFlat.pi_of_span_eq_top` — a finite product of `Away (f i)`
  localizations along a covering family (`span (range f) = ⊤`) is faithfully flat.
* `Algebra.TensorProduct.piRightAlgEquiv`, `piLeftAlgEquiv`, `piPiAlgEquiv` — tensor
  products distribute over finite products of algebras, as `A`-algebra equivalences, with
  pure-tensor `simp` formulas.
* `IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfDvd` — the canonical map `A[1/f] →ₐ[A] A[1/g]` for `f ∣ g`
  (any two such maps are equal: `IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton`).
* `IsLocalization.Away.tensor`, `IsLocalization.Away.tensorEquiv` — the tensor product of
  `Away f` and `Away g` localizations is an `Away (f * g)` localization, hence canonically
  isomorphic to any other model of it.

Everything is elementary commutative algebra; the file is deliberately scheme-free and
shaped for mathlib.
-/

For a scheme `X` over `Spec k` covered by two affine opens `U₀ ⊔ U₁ = ⊤`, this file
computes the degree-one cohomology of the structure sheaf (as a sheaf of `k`-modules on
the small Zariski site, `Sheaf.HModule`) as an explicit cokernel of a map of section
modules:

`H¹ₖ(X, 𝒪ₖ) ≃ₗ[k] Γ(X, U₀ ⊓ U₁) ⧸ range((s₀, s₁) ↦ s₀|_{U₀⊓U₁} - s₁|_{U₀⊓U₁})`

(`AlgebraicGeometry.TwoCover.h1CokEquiv`, with the cokernel carrier
`AlgebraicGeometry.TwoCover.H1Cok`). This is the computational access point for the genus
of a curve: `genus C = finrank k H¹ₖ(C, 𝒪_C)` becomes the corank of an explicit map of
function spaces.

**Hypotheses actually used**: `X` any scheme over `Spec k`, `IsAffineOpen U₀`,
`IsAffineOpen U₁`, `U₀ ⊔ U₁ = ⊤`. In particular *no* affineness (or even
quasi-compactness) hypothesis on the intersection `U₀ ⊓ U₁` is needed — unlike for the
classical Čech-complex identification, the derived-functor Mayer–Vietoris sequence of
`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.MayerVietoris` is exact regardless, and affineness of the
two pieces alone kills their `H¹'` (`IsAffineOpen.subsingleton_moduleKSheaf_hModule'_one`).

## Main declarations

* `Scheme.twoCoverSquare` — the Mayer–Vietoris square `(U₀ ⊓ U₁, U₀, U₁, ⊤)` on the
  small Zariski site of `X`, for a covering pair of opens.
* `Scheme.twoCoverH1LinearEquiv` — the general-coefficients form: for any sheaf `F` of
  `k`-modules with `H¹'(U₀, F)` and `H¹'(U₁, F)` subsingletons,
  `HModule F 1 ≃ₗ[k] F(U₀ ⊓ U₁) ⧸ range(moduleDiff)` (reusable for twisted sheaves).
* `TwoCover.diff k X U₀ U₁` — the difference map `Γ(U₀) × Γ(U₁) →ₗ[k] Γ(U₀ ⊓ U₁)`.
* `TwoCover.H1Cok k X U₀ U₁` — the cokernel carrier `Γ(U₀ ⊓ U₁) ⧸ range diff`.

  `h1Cok_mk_resHom_left/right` (classes of sections extending to `U₀` or `U₁` vanish).

along the structure morphism), activated as a local instance as in

/-! ## Descent 1-cocycles -/

/-- A **descent 1-cocycle** relative to `A → B`: a unit of `B ⊗[A] B`, normalized along
the multiplication map, satisfying the 1-cocycle identity in `B ⊗[A] (B ⊗[A] B)`.  For
`B = ∏ i, A_{fᵢ}` a finite product of localizations covering `Spec A`, this is exactly a
Čech 1-cocycle of units on the cover by the basic opens `D(fᵢ)`. -/
structure IsDescentCocycle (u : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ) : Prop where
  /-- Normalization: the multiplication `B ⊗[A] B → B` sends the cocycle to `1`. -/
  lmul'_eq_one : Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' A (S := B) u.val = 1
  /-- The 1-cocycle identity. -/
  cocycle : descentFace₂₃ A B u.val * descentFace₁₂ A B u.val = descentFace₁₃ A B u.val

/-- The trivial unit is a descent cocycle. -/
theorem IsDescentCocycle.one : IsDescentCocycle (1 : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ) where
  lmul'_eq_one := by simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
  cocycle := by simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]

/-- Descent cocycles are closed under multiplication. -/
theorem IsDescentCocycle.mul {u v : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ} (hu : IsDescentCocycle u)
    (hv : IsDescentCocycle v) : IsDescentCocycle (u * v) where
  lmul'_eq_one := by
    rw [Units.val_mul, map_mul, hu.lmul'_eq_one, hv.lmul'_eq_one, one_mul]
  cocycle := by
    simp only [Units.val_mul, map_mul]
    rw [show descentFace₂₃ A B u.val * descentFace₂₃ A B v.val *
          (descentFace₁₂ A B u.val * descentFace₁₂ A B v.val)
        = descentFace₂₃ A B u.val * descentFace₁₂ A B u.val *
          (descentFace₂₃ A B v.val * descentFace₁₂ A B v.val) by ring]
    rw [hu.cocycle, hv.cocycle]

/-! ## The descent datum of a cocycle -/

variable (u : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ)

variable (A B) in
/-- The coaction `x ↦ u * (x ⊗ₜ 1)` associated with a unit of `B ⊗[A] B`, as a `B`-linear
map (with `B` acting on the left tensor factor of the target). -/
noncomputable def unitCoaction : B →ₗ[B] B ⊗[A] B where
  toFun x := u.val * x ⊗ₜ 1
  map_add' x y := by rw [add_tmul, mul_add]
  map_smul' b x := by
    rw [RingHom.id_apply, ← smul_tmul', mul_smul_comm]

@[simp]
lemma unitCoaction_apply (x : B) : unitCoaction A B u x = u.val * x ⊗ₜ 1 := rfl

/-- The action map `B ⊗[A] B →ₗ[B] B` of `ModuleDescent` is the multiplication map. -/
lemma actionMap_eq_lmul' (w : B ⊗[A] B) :
    actionMap A B B w = Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' A (S := B) w := by
  induction w with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul b m => simp [smul_eq_mul]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]

/-- The base change to `B` of the coaction is left multiplication by `1 ⊗ₜ u` composed
with the face map `descentFace₁₂`. -/
lemma baseChange_unitCoaction (w : B ⊗[A] B) :
    ((unitCoaction A B u).restrictScalars A).baseChange B w
      = descentFace₂₃ A B u.val * descentFace₁₂ A B w := by
  induction w with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul y z =>
    -- LHS = `y ⊗ₜ (u * (z ⊗ₜ 1))`; RHS = `(1 ⊗ₜ u) * (y ⊗ₜ (z ⊗ₜ 1))`, equal by
    -- `Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul` and `one_mul`.
    simp only [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, unitCoaction_apply,
      descentFace₂₃_apply, descentFace₁₂_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy, mul_add]

/-- The base change to `B` of `x ↦ 1 ⊗ₜ x` is the face map `descentFace₁₃`. -/
lemma baseChange_mk_one (w : B ⊗[A] B) :
    (TensorProduct.mk A B B 1).baseChange B w = descentFace₁₃ A B w := by
  induction w with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul y z => rfl
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

/-- The descent datum on the `B`-module `B` associated with a descent 1-cocycle: the
coaction is `x ↦ u * (x ⊗ₜ 1)`; counitality is the normalization and coassociativity is
the cocycle identity. -/
noncomputable def DescentDatum.ofUnit (hu : IsDescentCocycle u) : DescentDatum A B B where
  coaction := unitCoaction A B u
  counit m := by
    rw [unitCoaction_apply, actionMap_eq_lmul', map_mul, hu.lmul'_eq_one, one_mul,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul'_apply_tmul, mul_one]
  coassoc m := by
    -- after rewriting, both sides are `descentFace₁₃ u * (m ⊗ₜ (1 ⊗ₜ 1))`
    rw [unitCoaction_apply, baseChange_unitCoaction, baseChange_mk_one, map_mul,
      ← mul_assoc, hu.cocycle, map_mul]
    simp only [descentFace₁₂_tmul, descentFace₁₃_tmul]

@[simp]
lemma ofUnit_coaction (hu : IsDescentCocycle u) :
    (DescentDatum.ofUnit u hu).coaction = unitCoaction A B u := rfl

/-- The descended `A`-module of a descent 1-cocycle: the submodule of `x : B` with
`u * (x ⊗ₜ 1) = 1 ⊗ₜ x`. -/
noncomputable def IsDescentCocycle.descended {u : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ} (hu : IsDescentCocycle u) :
    Submodule A B :=
  (DescentDatum.ofUnit u hu).descended

lemma IsDescentCocycle.mem_descended {u : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ} (hu : IsDescentCocycle u) {m : B} :
    m ∈ hu.descended ↔ u.val * m ⊗ₜ 1 = 1 ⊗ₜ m :=
  DescentDatum.mem_descended _

/-! ## The Picard class of a cocycle -/

section picClass

variable [Module.FaithfullyFlat A B]

/-- The descended module of a descent cocycle along a faithfully flat `A → B` is an
invertible `A`-module. -/
instance IsDescentCocycle.invertible_descended {u : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ}
    (hu : IsDescentCocycle u) : Module.Invertible A hu.descended :=
  (DescentDatum.ofUnit u hu).invertible_descended

/-- The class in the Picard group of `A` of the module descended from a descent
1-cocycle relative to a faithfully flat `A → B`. -/
noncomputable def IsDescentCocycle.picClass {u : (B ⊗[A] B)ˣ}
    (hu : IsDescentCocycle u) : CommRing.Pic A :=
  CommRing.Pic.mk A hu.descended

/-- The descended module of the trivial cocycle is `A` itself (Amitsur exactness in
degree `0`). -/
noncomputable def descendedOneEquiv :
    (IsDescentCocycle.one (A := A) (B := B)).descended ≃ₗ[A] A := by
  -- Route: `(DescentDatum.ofUnit 1 .one).equivDescended e he |>.symm` with
  -- `e : B ⊗[A] A ≃ₗ[B] B := AlgebraTensorModule.rid A B B`; the compatibility `he` is the
  -- computation `(a • b) ⊗ₜ 1 = b ⊗ₜ (a • 1)` (`tmul_smul` and `smul_tmul'`) on pure
  -- tensors, extended by linearity via `TensorProduct.induction_on`.
  refine ((DescentDatum.ofUnit 1 IsDescentCocycle.one).equivDescended
    (AlgebraTensorModule.rid A B B) fun x => ?_).symm
  induction x with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul b a =>
      simp only [ofUnit_coaction, unitCoaction_apply, Units.val_one, one_mul,
        DescentDatum.baseChange_coaction, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
        LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, AlgebraTensorModule.rid_tmul,
        TensorProduct.mk_apply, tmul_smul, smul_tmul']
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

@[simp]
theorem IsDescentCocycle.picClass_one :
    (IsDescentCocycle.one (A := A) (B := B)).picClass = 1 :=
  CommRing.Pic.mk_eq_one_iff.mpr ⟨descendedOneEquiv⟩

10	
11	For an object `C` of `Over (Spec k)` (`k` a field), a commutative `k`-algebra `A`, and a
12	quasi-compact quasi-separated open `V ⊆ C.left`, this file identifies the sections of the
13	base change `(C ⊗ Spec A).left` over the preimage `V_A := (fst C (Spec A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V` of
14	`V` under the first projection with the tensor product of the sections over `V`:
15	
16	`Γ(C.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≃+* Γ((C ⊗ overSpec k A).left, V_A)`
17	
18	(`AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChange`), sending `s ⊗ a` to the product of the two
19	pullbacks (`sectionsBaseChange_tmul`), compatibly with restriction along `W ≤ V`
20	(`sectionsBaseChange_naturality`). Here `C ⊗ T` is the cartesian-monoidal product of
21	`Over (Spec k)`, realized by `Limits.pullback`; the single bridge lemma between the two
22	languages is `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPullback_left`.
23	
24	This is brick 1 of the separatedness ledger (design §4.4): one brick, three consumers —
25	étale separatedness (arbitrary `A`), the dual-numbers tangent engine (`A = k[ε]`), and the
26	χ-ledger under field extension (`A = K`). Hence the statements are for an arbitrary
27	commutative `k`-algebra `A`, and `V` is allowed to be any quasi-compact quasi-separated
28	open (e.g. the intersection of two affines of the curve), not just an affine one.

323	  le_right : U₀₁ ≤ U₁

327	  isAffineOpen_U₀₁ : IsAffineOpen U₀₁

330	  /-- The sections on the left chart form a polynomial ring. -/
331	  Γ₀ : Γ(P1 k, U₀) ≃+* Polynomial k

333	  Γ₁ : Γ(P1 k, U₁) ≃+* Polynomial k
334	  /-- The sections on the overlap form a Laurent polynomial ring. -/
335	  Γ₀₁ : Γ(P1 k, U₀₁) ≃+* LaurentPolynomial k

9	/-!
10	# Separatedness brick 3: pullback along the projection is injective on Picard groups
11	
12	For `C` proper, geometrically irreducible and geometrically reduced over a field `k` and
13	**any** test object `T` over `Spec k`, pullback of Čech Picard classes along the second
14	projection `pr : (C ⊗ T).left ⟶ T.left` is injective
15	(`AlgebraicGeometry.Over.prPullback_injective`) — brick 3 of the separatedness ledger
16	(design §4.4), the cocycle recast of "a line bundle pulled back from the base which
17	trivializes on the product was trivial", the projection step of Kleiman,
18	*The Picard Scheme*, Theorem 2.5(1).
19	
20	## The section-level engine
21	
22	Everything reduces to the section rings: for an **affine** open `V ⊆ T.left`, pullback of
23	sections along the projection is bijective,
24	`Γ(T.left, V) ≅ Γ((C ⊗ T).left, pr⁻¹ V)` (`Over.isIso_appLE_snd`). This is brick 2
25	(`Over.isIso_appTop_snd_overSpec`, `Picard/UniversalSections.lean`) freed from its
26	`T = Spec A`, `V = ⊤` special case: the qcqs pushout square of
27	`Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Flat` is applied to the pullback square
28	`(C ⊗ T).left = C.left ×_{Spec k} T.left` with the *affine* slot at `V ⊆ T.left` and the
29	*qcqs* slot at `⊤ ⊆ C.left`, and the `k ≅ Γ(C.left, 𝒪)` leg (Wave 1) transfers the
30	isomorphism across the square. Flatness of `T.hom` is automatic over a field
31	(`AlgebraicGeometry.Flat.of_field`). By sheaf separation the injectivity half extends to
32	**arbitrary** opens `W ⊆ T.left` (`Over.appLE_snd_injective`), which is why no affineness
33	or quasi-separatedness hypothesis on `T` survives into the final statement.
34	
35	## The cocycle assembly
36	
37	A Picard class on `T` dying on `C ⊗ T` is represented, after refining to an affine
38	pointed cover `𝒰` (`Scheme.PointedCover.exists_isAffineOpen_le`), by a unit cocycle `γ`
39	whose pullback is — by refinement injectivity, `Picard/RefinementInjectivity.lean` — a
40	coboundary `w` **on the pulled-back cover itself**. Choosing a point `sec t` in each
41	fiber of the (surjective) projection, the trivializing units `w (sec t) ∈ 𝒪ˣ(pr⁻¹ 𝒰 t)`
42	descend through the section bijection (`Over.unitsAppLE_snd_bijective`) to units
43	`v t ∈ 𝒪ˣ(𝒰 t)`, and the coboundary relation for `v` follows from the one for `w` by
44	injectivity of pullback on `𝒰 t ⊓ 𝒰 t'`.
45	-/

91	    have : CompactSpace C.left := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace C.hom

138	      (show (snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ≤ (snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ W from

194	variable (C T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
195	  [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
196	
197	/-- The projection `(C ⊗ T).left ⟶ T.left` is surjective: `C.hom` is surjective (its
198	source is irreducible, hence nonempty, and its target is a point), and surjectivity is
199	stable under base change. -/
200	instance surjective_snd_left : Surjective (snd C T).left :=
201	  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @Surjective) (Over.isPullback_left C T)
202	    inferInstance
203	
204	/-- The descent step for `prPullback_injective`, with the fiber points and the descended
205	units abstracted: if the pullback cocycle of `γ` is the coboundary of `w`, and `vt, vt'`
206	pull back to the trivializing units of `w` at points `z, z'` of the product lying over
207	`t, t'`, then `vt, vt'` satisfy the coboundary relation for `γ` at `(t, t')`. The
208	equations `hz, hz'` let the fiber-point choices be substituted away. -/
209	private lemma descend_coboundary {𝒰 : T.left.PointedCover}
210	    (γ : T.left.unitsCocycle 𝒰)
211	    (w : ∀ z : (C ⊗ T).left,
212	      Γ((C ⊗ T).left, (𝒰.pullback (snd C T).left).opens z)ˣ)
213	    (hw : ∀ z z',
214	      (C ⊗ T).left.unitsRestrict
215	          (inf_le_left : (𝒰.pullback (snd C T).left).opens z
216	              ⊓ (𝒰.pullback (snd C T).left).opens z'
217	            ≤ (𝒰.pullback (snd C T).left).opens z) (w z)
218	          * Scheme.unitsEvInf ((snd C T).left.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ) z z'
219	        = (C ⊗ T).left.unitsRestrict inf_le_right (w z'))
220	    (z z' : (C ⊗ T).left) (t t' : T.left)
221	    (hz : (snd C T).left.base z = t) (hz' : (snd C T).left.base z' = t')
222	    (hzle : (snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens t ≤ (𝒰.pullback (snd C T).left).opens z)
223	    (hz'le : (snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens t' ≤ (𝒰.pullback (snd C T).left).opens z')
224	    (vt : Γ(T.left, 𝒰.opens t)ˣ) (vt' : Γ(T.left, 𝒰.opens t')ˣ)
225	    (hvt : (snd C T).left.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens t) ((snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens t)
226	        le_rfl vt = (C ⊗ T).left.unitsRestrict hzle (w z))
227	    (hvt' : (snd C T).left.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens t') ((snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens t')
228	        le_rfl vt' = (C ⊗ T).left.unitsRestrict hz'le (w z')) :
229	    T.left.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left : 𝒰.opens t ⊓ 𝒰.opens t' ≤ 𝒰.opens t) vt
230	        * Scheme.unitsEvInf γ t t'
231	      = T.left.unitsRestrict inf_le_right vt' := by
232	  subst hz hz'
233	  -- apply injectivity of pullback of unit sections on `𝒰 (pr z) ⊓ 𝒰 (pr z')`
234	  have hinj : Function.Injective ((snd C T).left.unitsAppLE
235	      (𝒰.opens ((snd C T).left.base z) ⊓ 𝒰.opens ((snd C T).left.base z'))
236	      ((snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ
237	        (𝒰.opens ((snd C T).left.base z) ⊓ 𝒰.opens ((snd C T).left.base z')))
238	      le_rfl) :=
239	    fun a b hab ↦ Units.ext (appLE_snd_injective C T _ (congrArg Units.val hab))
240	  apply hinj
241	  rw [map_mul]
242	  -- the descended units, restricted to `pr⁻¹(𝒰 (pr z) ⊓ 𝒰 (pr z'))`
243	  have e₁ := congrArg ((C ⊗ T).left.unitsRestrict
244	    (fun y hy ↦ hy.1 : (snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ
245	        (𝒰.opens ((snd C T).left.base z) ⊓ 𝒰.opens ((snd C T).left.base z'))
246	      ≤ (snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens ((snd C T).left.base z))) hvt
247	  rw [Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map, Scheme.unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict] at e₁
248	  have e₂ := congrArg ((C ⊗ T).left.unitsRestrict
249	    (fun y hy ↦ hy.2 : (snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ
250	        (𝒰.opens ((snd C T).left.base z) ⊓ 𝒰.opens ((snd C T).left.base z'))
251	      ≤ (snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens ((snd C T).left.base z'))) hvt'
252	  rw [Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map, Scheme.unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict] at e₂
253	  -- the coboundary relation for `w`, restricted to `pr⁻¹(𝒰 (pr z) ⊓ 𝒰 (pr z'))`
254	  have e₃ := congrArg ((C ⊗ T).left.unitsRestrict
255	    (fun y hy ↦ ⟨hy.1, hy.2⟩ : (snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ
256	        (𝒰.opens ((snd C T).left.base z) ⊓ 𝒰.opens ((snd C T).left.base z'))
257	      ≤ (𝒰.pullback (snd C T).left).opens z
258	          ⊓ (𝒰.pullback (snd C T).left).opens z')) (hw z z')
259	  rw [map_mul, Scheme.unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict, Scheme.unitsRestrict_unitsRestrict,
260	    Scheme.Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf, Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map] at e₃
261	  -- assemble
262	  rw [Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE, e₁, e₂]
263	  exact e₃
264	
265	/-- **Brick 3 of the separatedness ledger** (design §4.4; the projection step of Kleiman,
266	*The Picard Scheme*, Theorem 2.5(1)): for `C` proper, geometrically irreducible and
267	geometrically reduced over the field `k` and **any** `T` over `Spec k`, pullback of Čech
268	Picard classes along the second projection `(C ⊗ T).left ⟶ T.left` is injective. -/
269	theorem prPullback_injective :
270	    Function.Injective (Scheme.CechPic.map (X := (C ⊗ T).left) (snd C T).left) := by
271	  -- the `H¹`-level heart, on an affine pointed cover
272	  have H : ∀ (𝒰 : T.left.PointedCover), (∀ t, IsAffineOpen (𝒰.opens t)) →
273	      ∀ a : T.left.unitsH1 𝒰, (snd C T).left.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a = 1 → a = 1 := by
274	    intro 𝒰 haff a ha
275	    induction a using Quot.ind with | _ γ =>
276	    replace ha : ((snd C T).left.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).class = OneCocycle.class 1 := ha
277	    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ :=
278	      (OneCocycle.isCohomologous_iff_evInf _ _).mp ((OneCocycle.class_eq_iff _ _).mp ha)
279	    -- the coboundary data, in `Γ`-typed form
280	    have hw' : ∀ z z',
281	        (C ⊗ T).left.unitsRestrict
282	            (inf_le_left : (𝒰.pullback (snd C T).left).opens z
283	                ⊓ (𝒰.pullback (snd C T).left).opens z'
284	              ≤ (𝒰.pullback (snd C T).left).opens z) (w z)
285	            * Scheme.unitsEvInf ((snd C T).left.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ) z z'
286	          = (C ⊗ T).left.unitsRestrict inf_le_right (w z') := by
287	      intro z z'
288	      have h1 := hw z z'
289	      rw [OneCocycle.one_evInf, one_mul] at h1
290	      exact h1
291	    -- choose a point in each fiber of the projection, descend the trivializing units
292	    obtain ⟨sec, hsec⟩ := (snd C T).left.surjective.hasRightInverse
293	    have hchoice : ∀ t, ∃ v : Γ(T.left, 𝒰.opens t)ˣ,
294	        (snd C T).left.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens t) ((snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens t) le_rfl v
295	          = (C ⊗ T).left.unitsRestrict
296	              (le_of_eq (by rw [Scheme.PointedCover.pullback_opens, hsec t]) :
297	                (snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens t
298	                  ≤ (𝒰.pullback (snd C T).left).opens (sec t)) (w (sec t)) :=
299	      fun t ↦ (unitsAppLE_snd_bijective C T (haff t)).surjective _
300	    choose v hv using hchoice
301	    -- the descended units witness the coboundary relation for `γ`
302	    rw [show (1 : T.left.unitsH1 𝒰) = OneCocycle.class 1 from rfl]
303	    refine (OneCocycle.class_eq_iff _ _).mpr
304	      ((OneCocycle.isCohomologous_iff_evInf _ _).mpr ⟨v, fun t t' ↦ ?_⟩)
305	    rw [OneCocycle.one_evInf, one_mul]
306	    exact descend_coboundary C T γ w hw' (sec t) (sec t') t t' (hsec t) (hsec t')
307	      _ _ (v t) (v t') (hv t) (hv t')
308	  -- assembly: refine to an affine pointed cover and use `CechPic.mk_eq_one_iff`
309	  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_one _).mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_
310	  induction x using Scheme.CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰₀ a₀ =>
311	  obtain ⟨𝒰, hle, haff⟩ := 𝒰₀.exists_isAffineOpen_le
312	  rw [← Scheme.CechPic.mk_unitsRes hle] at hx ⊢
313	  rw [Scheme.CechPic.map_mk, Scheme.CechPic.mk_eq_one_iff] at hx
314	  rw [Scheme.CechPic.mk_eq_one_iff]
315	  exact H 𝒰 haff _ hx

9	# The projective line over a field, with usable charts
10	
11	We define `AlgebraicGeometry.P1 k` as `Proj` of the standard graded polynomial ring
12	`k[X₀, X₁]` (`MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k` with the degree grading), together with:
13	
14	* `P1.structureMap : P1 k ⟶ Spec (.of k)`, and the instance `IsProper (P1.structureMap k)`
15	  (inherited from mathlib's properness of `Proj`);
16	* the two standard affine charts `D₊(X₀)`, `D₊(X₁)` (`P1.chartOpen`), which cover `P1 k`
17	  (`P1.chartOpen_sup`), together with the open immersions `P1.chartι i` from the affine
18	  models `Spec (k[X₀,X₁]_(Xᵢ))₀`;
19	* identifications of the chart section rings with polynomial rings:
20	  `P1.awayAlgEquiv : (k[X₀,X₁]_(Xᵢ))₀ ≃ₐ[k] k[t]` (the coordinate is `t = Xⱼ/Xᵢ`).
21	
22	The identification of the chart *overlap* with Laurent polynomials, the section-level
23	versions, and the bundled chart package `AlgebraicGeometry.LaurentChartPair` are in the
24	continuation file `AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.P1Charts`.
25	
26	The generic instance `Algebra R (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x)` (for a graded `R`-algebra) and
27	the lemma `LaurentPolynomial.exists_toLaurent_add_aeval` (*Laurent span*: every Laurent
28	polynomial is the sum of a polynomial in `T` and a polynomial in `T⁻¹`) are general-purpose
29	and live in their natural namespaces.
30	
31	## Implementation notes
32	
33	We install `MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra` as a (project-global) instance: everywhere in this
34	project, `MvPolynomial` carries the standard degree grading. Mathlib leaves this to the user
35	because other gradings exist; this project only ever uses the standard one.
36	-/

311	noncomputable def awayToPoly (i : Fin 2) : Away 𝒜 (X i) →ₐ[k] Polynomial k where
312	  toRingHom :=
313	    (Localization.awayLift (dehomogenize k i).toRingHom (X i)
314	      (isUnit_dehomogenize_X_self k i)).comp
315	      (algebraMap (Away 𝒜 (X i)) (Localization.Away (X i : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))
316	  commutes' r := by
317	    change (Localization.awayLift (dehomogenize k i).toRingHom (X i)
318	        (isUnit_dehomogenize_X_self k i))
319	        ((algebraMap k (Away 𝒜 (X i)) r).val) = algebraMap k (Polynomial k) r
320	    rw [HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_val, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]

324	theorem awayToPoly_mk (i : Fin 2) (n : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)
325	    (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 (n • 1)) :
326	    awayToPoly k i (Away.mk 𝒜 (X_mem k i) n a ha) = dehomogenize k i a := by
327	  have h1 : (dehomogenize k i).toRingHom (X i) * 1 = 1 := by
328	    rw [mul_one]
329	    exact dehomogenize_X_self k i
330	  have h := Localization.awayLift_mk (A := Polynomial k)
331	    ((dehomogenize k i).toRingHom) (X i) a 1 h1 n

368	    (H : (∏ l, (X l : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) ^ e l) ∈ 𝒜 (a • 1)) :

378	theorem polyToAway_surjective {i j : Fin 2} (hij : i ≠ j) :
379	    Function.Surjective (polyToAway k i j) := by
380	  intro z
381	  have hz : z ∈ (⊤ : Submodule (𝒜 0) (Away 𝒜 (X i))) := trivial
382	  rw [← Away.span_mk_prod_pow_eq_top (X_mem k i) X (adjoin_gradeZero_range_X k)

384	  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
385	  | mem w hw =>
386	    obtain ⟨a, e, hae, rfl⟩ := hw
387	    refine ⟨Polynomial.X ^ e j, ?_⟩
388	    rw [map_pow, polyToAway_X]
389	    exact (away_mk_prod_eq k hij a e (by simpa using hae) _).symm
390	  | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
391	  | add u v _ _ hu hv =>
392	    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hu
393	    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hv
394	    exact ⟨p + q, map_add _ _ _⟩
395	  | smul c w _ hw =>
396	    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hw
397	    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := (gradeZeroAlgEquiv k).surjective c
398	    refine ⟨r • p, ?_⟩
399	    rw [map_smul]
400	    change r • polyToAway k i j p = (algebraMap k (𝒜 0) r) • polyToAway k i j p
401	    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_assoc, one_smul]

9	/-!
10	# The Picard class of a unit Čech cocycle on an affine scheme
11	
12	For an affine scheme `X`, a unit Čech cocycle `γ` on a pointed cover `𝒰` determines a
13	class in mathlib's Picard group `CommRing.Pic Γ(X, ⊤)`, by faithfully flat descent along
14	a finite basic refinement of `𝒰`:
15	
16	* `Scheme.PointedCover.BasicRefinement`: finitely many points `pt i` and sections
17	  `r i : Γ(X, ⊤)` with `X.basicOpen (r i) ≤ 𝒰.opens (pt i)`, covering `X`.  Such data
18	  always exists (`BasicRefinement.nonempty`): basic opens form a basis of an affine
19	  scheme, which is quasi-compact.
20	* `BasicRefinement.coverCocycle γ`: the evaluations `γ (pt i, pt j)` restricted to the
21	  pairwise overlaps `X.basicOpen (r i * r j)` — a Čech cocycle of units on the finite
22	  localization cover `r` in the sense of `IsLocalization.AwayCover.IsCoverCocycle`
23	  (`BasicRefinement.isCoverCocycle`; the canonical algebra maps between localizations
24	  agree with restriction of sections by uniqueness, `Scheme.basicOpen_algHom_ext`).
25	* `BasicRefinement.pic γ : CommRing.Pic Γ(X, ⊤)`: the Picard class of the invertible
26	  module descended from the associated descent 1-cocycle
27	  (`AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.UnitDescent`) along the faithfully flat cover algebra
28	  `∀ i, Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r i))`.
29	
30	The independence of `pic γ` from all choices, and the resulting group homomorphism
31	`X.CechPic →* CommRing.Pic Γ(X, ⊤)`, are established in
32	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicAffine`.
33	-/

48	/-! ## Basic refinements of a pointed cover -/
49	
50	/-- A finite basic refinement of a pointed cover of a scheme: finitely many points and
51	sections whose basic opens refine the cover at those points and still cover `X`.  The
52	index type is a field, so that refinements can be merged (`BasicRefinement.inter`). -/
53	structure PointedCover.BasicRefinement (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : Type (u + 1) where
54	  /-- The index type of the refinement. -/
55	  ι : Type u
56	  /-- The index type is finite. -/
57	  [fintype : Fintype ι]
58	  /-- The index type has decidable equality. -/
59	  [decEq : DecidableEq ι]
60	  /-- The chosen points. -/
61	  pt : ι → X
62	  /-- The sections cutting out the basic opens. -/
63	  r : ι → Γ(X, ⊤)
64	  /-- Each basic open refines the cover at its point. -/
65	  basicOpen_le : ∀ i, X.basicOpen (r i) ≤ 𝒰.opens (pt i)
66	  /-- The basic opens cover `X`. -/
67	  iSup_eq : (⨆ i, X.basicOpen (r i)) = ⊤

71	attribute [instance] fintype decEq

73	/-- Every pointed cover of an affine scheme admits a finite basic refinement: basic
74	opens form a basis and the space is quasi-compact. -/
75	theorem nonempty [IsAffine X] (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : Nonempty 𝒰.BasicRefinement := by
76	  have hex : ∀ x : X, ∃ f : Γ(X, ⊤), X.basicOpen f ≤ 𝒰.opens x ∧ x ∈ X.basicOpen f :=
77	    fun x ↦ (isAffineOpen_top X).exists_basicOpen_le
78	      (⟨x, 𝒰.mem_opens x⟩ : (𝒰.opens x : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)) trivial
79	  choose f hf₁ hf₂ using hex
80	  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IsCompact.elim_finite_subcover isCompact_univ
81	    (fun x : X ↦ (X.basicOpen (f x) : Set X)) (fun x ↦ (X.basicOpen (f x)).isOpen)
82	    (fun x _ ↦ Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x, hf₂ x⟩)
83	  letI : DecidableEq X := Classical.decEq X
84	  refine ⟨{ ι := ↥t, pt := fun y ↦ (y : X), r := fun y ↦ f (y : X),
85	            basicOpen_le := fun y ↦ hf₁ _, iSup_eq := ?_ }⟩
86	  rw [eq_top_iff]
87	  intro x _
88	  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht (Set.mem_univ x))
89	  exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy.1⟩, hy.2⟩
90	
91	/-- Merging two basic refinements: the products of the sections, indexed by pairs, with
92	the points of the **second** refinement.  The result refines every pointed cover that the
93	second refinement refines. -/
94	@[simps]
95	def inter {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (P : 𝒰.BasicRefinement) (Q : 𝒱.BasicRefinement) :
96	    𝒱.BasicRefinement where
97	  ι := P.ι × Q.ι
98	  pt p := Q.pt p.2
99	  r p := P.r p.1 * Q.r p.2
100	  basicOpen_le p := ((X.basicOpen_mul _ _).trans_le inf_le_right).trans (Q.basicOpen_le p.2)
101	  iSup_eq := by
102	    rw [eq_top_iff]
103	    intro x _
104	    have hxP : x ∈ ⨆ i, X.basicOpen (P.r i) := P.iSup_eq.ge trivial
105	    have hxQ : x ∈ ⨆ j, X.basicOpen (Q.r j) := Q.iSup_eq.ge trivial
106	    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hxP
107	    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hxQ
108	    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨(i, j), (X.basicOpen_mul _ _).ge ⟨hi, hj⟩⟩
109

112	/-- The overlap of two members of the refinement is contained in the overlap of the
113	corresponding members of the pointed cover. -/
114	lemma overlap_le (i j : P.ι) :
115	    X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j) ≤ 𝒰.opens (P.pt i) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (P.pt j) :=
116	  (X.basicOpen_mul _ _).trans_le (inf_le_inf (P.basicOpen_le i) (P.basicOpen_le j))
117	
118	lemma basicOpen_le_mul_self (i : P.ι) :
119	    X.basicOpen (P.r i) ≤ X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r i) :=
120	  le_of_le_of_eq (le_inf le_rfl le_rfl) (X.basicOpen_mul _ _).symm
121	
122	lemma _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.basicOpen_le_of_dvd {f g : Γ(X, ⊤)} (h : f ∣ g) :
123	    X.basicOpen g ≤ X.basicOpen f := by
124	  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := h
125	  exact (X.basicOpen_mul f c).trans_le inf_le_left
126	
127	lemma mul_le_left (i j : P.ι) :
128	    X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j) ≤ X.basicOpen (P.r i) :=
129	  (X.basicOpen_mul _ _).trans_le inf_le_left
130	
131	lemma mul_le_right (i j : P.ι) :
132	    X.basicOpen (P.r i * P.r j) ≤ X.basicOpen (P.r j) :=
133	  (X.basicOpen_mul _ _).trans_le inf_le_right
134	
135	/-- The triple overlap is contained in each double overlap. -/

A morphism of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y` is affine if the preimage

    pullback.map _ _ _ _ U.ι (Scheme.Opens.ι _) W.ι (by simp [f']) (by simp [q])

    IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f) ↔
      ∀ (U : Y.Opens), IsAffineOpen U → ∀ V₁ ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U, ∀ V₂ ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U,

/-- A morphism of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y` induces a local ring homomorphism from
`Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)` to `X.presheaf.stalk x` for any `x : X`. -/
def stalkMap (x : X) : Y.presheaf.stalk (f x) ⟶ X.presheaf.stalk x :=
  f.toLRSHom.stalkMap x

protected lemma ext {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h_base : f.base = g.base)
    (h_app : ∀ U, f.app U ≫ X.presheaf.map
      (eqToHom congr((Opens.map $h_base.symm).obj U)).op = g.app U) : f = g := by
  cases f; cases g; congr 1
  apply LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.ext'
  ext : 1
  · exact h_base
  · exact TopCat.Presheaf.ext (fun U ↦ by simpa using! h_app U)

/-- An alternative ext lemma for scheme morphisms. -/
protected lemma ext' {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f.toLRSHom = g.toLRSHom) : f = g := by
  cases f; cases g; congr 1

Given morphism properties `P` and `Q` we say that `P` descends along `Q` (`P.DescendsAlong Q`),
if whenever `Q` holds for `X ⟶ Z`, `P` holds for `X ×[Z] Y ⟶ X` implies `P` holds for `Y ⟶ Z`.

namespace CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty

open Limits

variable {C : Type*} [Category* C]

variable {P Q W : MorphismProperty C}

/-- `P` descends along `Q` if whenever `Q` holds for `X ⟶ Z`,
`P` holds for `X ×[Z] Y ⟶ X` implies `P` holds for `Y ⟶ Z`. -/
class DescendsAlong (P Q : MorphismProperty C) : Prop where
  of_isPullback {A X Y Z : C} {fst : A ⟶ X} {snd : A ⟶ Y} {f : X ⟶ Z} {g : Y ⟶ Z} :
    IsPullback fst snd f g → Q f → P fst → P g

section DescendsAlong

variable {A X Y Z : C} {fst : A ⟶ X} {snd : A ⟶ Y} {f : X ⟶ Z} {g : Y ⟶ Z}

lemma of_isPullback_of_descendsAlong [P.DescendsAlong Q] (h : IsPullback fst snd f g)
    (hf : Q f) (hfst : P fst) : P g :=

    (hf : Q f) : P fst ↔ P g :=

lemma of_pullback_fst_of_descendsAlong [P.DescendsAlong Q] [HasPullback f g] (hf : Q f)
    (hfst : P (pullback.fst f g)) : P g :=
  of_isPullback_of_descendsAlong (.of_hasPullback f g) hf hfst

lemma pullback_fst_iff [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [P.DescendsAlong Q] [HasPullback f g]
    (hf : Q f) : P (pullback.fst f g) ↔ P g :=
  iff_of_isPullback (.of_hasPullback f g) hf

lemma of_pullback_snd_of_descendsAlong [P.DescendsAlong Q] [HasPullback f g] (hg : Q g)
